topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The walls of the classroom feel a bit too close today. I keep looking at the paper in my hands, the words blurring into a mess of ink. The accusations seem to hang in the air, thick and heavy. I try to speak, but my throat feels dry, and the words come out wrong, twisted. I know I’ve studied hard, poured over books late into the night. But now, the room seems to spin, and I can’t find my footing. I want to explain, to make them see, but every attempt just feels like I’m sinking deeper.
